newsitem.title: USA: Excel expects to report record '96 results.
newsitem.headline: Excel expects to report record '96 results.

text.p: Excel Industries Inc said Thursday it expects to report record results for 1996.
The company's previous records were set in 1994, with earnings of $17.2 million, or $1.60 per primary share, on sales of $607 million.
"Because of the acquisition of Atwood Industries and our improving response to margin pressures, Excel's earnings level has risen substantially," Chairman James Futterknecht Jr said in a statement.
In 1995 Excel earned $16.3 million, or $1.52 per primary share, on sales of $596 million.
The company is a supplier to the automotive, heavy truck, recreational vehicle and bus industries. It produces window, door and seating systems and complex injection-molded parts.
Excel is expected to report year-end results during the third week of February.
